projects.name: Goodstuff Designs
projects.tagline: The parent website - managed IT, web, hosting & AI
projects.description: The Goodstuff Designs flagship website and creator of this Project Vault. A full South African IT business site: managed IT support, business networks, Vox connectivity, Kaspersky security, web development, managed Linux hosting, AI workflows and the Goodstuff-Studio desktop product. This entry showcases the live site only - its source code and internal assets are not part of the vault.

projects.name: FORMA
projects.tagline: Spaces shaped by light and silence
projects.description: A restrained, editorial website for an architecture studio. The Spruce & Brass theme pairs deep spruce green with warm bone paper and brass accents, built around Fraunces display type and an Archivo grotesque. Scroll-driven reveals, a project gallery and a quiet, premium atmosphere.
projects.cover: ProjectSetOne/forma/Screenshot 2026-11-21 at 21-27-02 FORMA - Architecture Studio Spaces shaped by light and silence.png

projects.name: Goodstuff - Digital, Supercharged
projects.tagline: The playful face of the brand
projects.description: A full creative agency website for Goodstuff Designs: web design, hosting, IT support and AI services with atmosphere photography, a work portfolio grid and a polished multi-service marketing structure powered by a 21KB interaction layer. Companion piece to the parent site.
projects.cover: ProjectSetOne/Fun Website/Screenshot 2026-11-21 at 21-27-29 Goodstuff Designs - Digital Supercharged Web Design Hosting IT & AI.png

projects.name: The Honest Hour
projects.tagline: What is your salary, per hour, really?
projects.description: A sharp web calculator that converts your salary into your true hourly rate - factoring taxes, unpaid hours and hidden costs. A utility with a strong editorial voice and focused interaction design.
projects.cover: ProjectSetOne/honest-hour/Screenshot 2026-11-21 at 21-27-46 The Honest Hour - What is your salary per hour really.png

projects.name: SOMA
projects.description: SOMA is a concept studio site built around the idea of a space that is alive - organic motion, breathing layouts and a 25KB JavaScript engine (living.js) driving ambient, living-page behaviour.
projects.cover: ProjectSetOne/Living/Screenshot 2026-11-21 at 21-28-00 SOMA - a living studio.png

projects.name: Pressrum
projects.tagline: A small studio for brands set in type
projects.description: A quiet Scandinavian print-studio portfolio. Mineral paper tones, green-black ink and a single signal-orange accent, self-hosted Switzer type, GSAP SplitText hero sequence, Lenis smooth scroll, film-graded photography and full dark-mode support. One of the most refined builds in the vault.
projects.cover: ProjectSetOne/pressrum/Screenshot 2026-11-21 at 21-28-23 Pressrum - a small studio for brands set in type.png

projects.name: Umbra
projects.tagline: A field guide to the darkest places on Earth
projects.description: Umbra re-imagines dark places as a browsable atlas. Its signature interaction is a pointer-following red torch that reveals hidden stars across the hero, with a static star field fallback for touch and reduced-motion users. Spectral + Karla on obsidian.
projects.cover: ProjectSetOne/umbra/Screenshot 2026-11-21 at 21-28-48 Umbra - a field guide to the darkest places on Earth.png

projects.name: Wouldvest
projects.tagline: What would your habit be worth?
projects.description: A financial thought-experiment: enter a habit - coffee, takeaways, subscriptions - and Wouldvest projects what investing that money instead could compound into over time. Clean calculator UX with a persuasive editorial frame.
projects.cover: ProjectSetOne/Wouldvest/Screenshot 2026-11-21 at 21-29-01 Wouldvest - What would your habit be worth.png

projects.name: Orbit
projects.tagline: Reporting on generative 3D and world models
projects.description: An editorial publication covering generative 3D and world models - research updates, model releases and commentary on the spatial-AI frontier, presented in a refined reading-first layout.
projects.cover: ProjectSetOne/orbit/Screenshot 2026-11-21 at 21-32-34 Orbit - reporting on generative 3D and world models.png

projects.name: Golden Touch Equine
projects.description: A professional service website for Golden Touch Equine Performance & Rehabilitation - certified equine sports massage. Warm, trustworthy presentation aimed at horse owners, with service detail and booking-oriented structure.
projects.cover: ProjectSetOne/Equine/Screenshot 2026-11-21 at 21-33-32 Certified Equine Sport & Rehabilitation Massage Golden Touch Equine.png

projects.name: Tech Lines Background
projects.description: A lightweight animated background experiment: a moving tech/circuit line field rendered on canvas, built as a drop-in backdrop for dashboards, hero sections and product pages.

projects.name: Wishy Washy
projects.tagline: Carpet cleaning - so fresh you'll notice from the door
projects.description: A local-services marketing site for Wishy Washy carpet cleaning: bold claims, service walkthrough and conversion-focused layout aimed at getting the phone to ring.
projects.cover: ProjectSetOne/wishywashy/Screenshot 2026-11-21 at 21-35-36 Wishy Washy - Carpet Cleaning So Fresh You'll Notice From the Door.png

projects.name: AXIOM
projects.description: A full operations dashboard interface: live metrics, mission-control panels and dense data visualisation in a 22KB stylesheet and 24KB application script. The most application-like build in the vault - closer to a SaaS product shell than a website.

projects.name: Meridian Global
projects.tagline: Infrastructure intelligence for the enterprise era
projects.description: A flagship enterprise SaaS landing site for Meridian Global. Corporate-grade typography, structured feature architecture and an infrastructure-intelligence narrative - built as a serious competitor to real enterprise marketing sites.
projects.cover: ProjectSetTwo/flagship/Infrastructure Intelligence for the Enterprise Era.png

projects.name: THE ANTI AGENCY
projects.description: A deliberate anti-design experiment - a 39KB single-file site that breaks the rules of agency websites on purpose: brutal layout, confrontational copy and intentional discomfort. A pure design statement.
projects.cover: ProjectSetTwo/THE ANTI AGENCY/THE ANTI AGENCY - built wrong on purpose.png

projects.name: THE DIGITAL UNIVERSE
projects.description: A 41KB single-file immersive web experience exploring a 'digital universe' theme - space-scale visuals, layered animation and a maximalist, futuristic aesthetic packed into one HTML document.

projects.name: THE DIGITAL UNIVERSE 2
projects.tagline: The second iteration - bigger, denser, stranger
projects.description: The sequel to The Digital Universe: a 43KB single-file experiment that pushes the concept further with denser visuals, more motion layers and an evolved futuristic art direction.
projects.cover: ProjectSetTwo/THE DIGITAL UNIVERSE 2/Screenshot 2026-11-21 at 21-25-48 THE DIGITAL UNIVERSE.png

projects.name: NEXUS OS
projects.description: A structured, three-file build (css/js/html) presenting NEXUS OS - a fictional next-generation operating system landing page with a full 'future is now' narrative and modular front-end architecture.
projects.cover: ProjectSetTwo/THE FUTURE IS NOW/Screenshot 2026-11-21 at 21-26-10 NEXUS OS - THE FUTURE IS NOW.png

projects.name: AURELE
projects.description: A 41KB single-file luxury experience for AURELE, a fictional Swiss haute horlogerie maison. Gold-on-black elegance, editorial product storytelling and slow, deliberate motion - the most opulent design in the vault.
